# Gitea fixture provenance

`local-gitea-28.3.0.json` contains nine actual HTTP responses captured on 2026-11-04 from an isolated Gitea 28.3.0 container bound to loopback. The account, repository, branches, issues, comments and pull request were created solely for this local acceptance. Authentication headers and tokens were not captured. Method/path/status, selected nonsecret response headers and response JSON are retained. The capture's `response` field was renamed to `body` for the offline test; upstream JSON content was not rewritten.

The captured calls cover `/api/v1/user`, `/user/repos`, repository details, two explicit issue pages, an additional issue list, pull requests and issue comments. `TestCapturedGiteaResponses` decodes these real payloads; where the capture query differs from the operation defaults, pagination is checked with the exact captured query. `TestLocalServiceAcceptance` separately verified the actual runtime against the isolated service including create/read-back and a PR.

Other inline response bodies are clearly **synthetic boundary variants**, including IDs above 2^53, malformed success bodies and hostile continuation URLs. They are not claimed to be server captures. Protocol authorities: [Gitea v28.3.0 Swagger](https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/blob/v28.3.0/templates/swagger/v1-swagger.generated.json), [API authentication/pagination documentation](https://docs.gitea.com/development/api-usage/), and [release](https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/releases/tag/v28.3.0). The specification's `Repository`, `Issue`, `PullRequest`, `Comment`, `CreateIssueOption` and `CreatePullRequestOption` definitions were inspected before declaration. No production service or account was accessed.
